verdict.rationale: Bento's broadcast docs say the API can be used to create campaigns and schedule approved sends with explicit audience rules. This is backed by a documented API reference browser, auth conventions, and error docs, and the CLI and MCP surfaces can also create broadcasts. Missing for 10: endpoint-level detail on scheduling parameters, clarity on whether "approved sends" requires a dashboard approval step, and independent or hands-on corroboration (no OpenAPI spec was found at the standard paths).
